visual_format: drawn illustration (bedside scene with two text blocks)
visual_text: One small hospice study of 5 people
Can people hear near the end of life?
What it found: in 5 people who had stopped responding, all 5 showed a brain response to a change in tones.
What it did not show: that they understood what they heard.
alt_text: Illustration of an older woman with a hearing aid in bed and a young man sitting beside her. Text: in one small hospice study of 5 unresponsive people, all 5 showed a brain response to tone changes; it did not show they understood what they heard.
